Description: Elastic Cloud Connectors federated identity role for AWS — canonical base blueprint for single-account deployments. The cloud-iac-provisioner loads this template and applies RFC 6902 patches from each enabled integration to append the required IAM policies.

ElasticResourceId.Description: Elastic resource ID. Used to construct the ExternalId trust condition, uniquely scoping this role to the Elastic deployment.

ElasticRoleARN.Description: Elastic's super-role ARN that this role will trust. Change only for non-production Elastic environments.

RoleArn.Description: ARN of the Elastic Cloud Connectors role. Supply this to the Elastic platform when configuring the integration.

ExternalId.Description: UUID fragment used as part of the ExternalId trust condition. Supply this to the Elastic platform when configuring the integration.
